alt: A colorful, bird-shaped wooden sign for "Annie's Rustic Cut," advertising "Home of the Best Roast Beef" with illustrations of food and drinks, stands on a grassy lawn surrounded by potted mums and pumpkins.
A colorful, psychedelic-style bird-shaped sign for "White Lake Homes" features peace symbols, flowers, a bald eagle, and the slogan "Live Like You've Dreamed!"

A whimsical, bird-shaped wooden sign painted with a vibrant camping scene featuring a family around a campfire, colorful tents, a vintage trailer, and a pink sky, set against a backdrop of autumn leaves.

A large, colorful, bird-shaped sign with a psychedelic 1960s design stands in a grassy area, featuring illustrations and text for local businesses like "The Famous Hotel Taft New York" and "Annie's Ruff Cut," surrounded by potted mums and pumpkins.

A colorful, psychedelic bird sculpture painted with peace signs, flowers, and sunflowers features the text "White Lake Homes (est. 1956) Woodstock" and "Peace Love & Happiness" while standing in a landscaped garden bed.

A smiling woman stands next to a large, colorful bird-shaped sign painted in a psychedelic style, featuring peace symbols and the word "LIBERTY" surrounded by names of local businesses like "Sullivan's" and "Liberty Theater."

A smiling woman in a black shirt and jeans stands next to a colorful, bird-shaped sign for the "Reel Harmony Songwriter Festival" that features musical instruments and the words "Peace Love and Music."
Two women crouch on a lawn beside a colorful, psychedelic bird-shaped sign for "Hector's Inn Original Woodstock Watering Hole" that features peace signs, flowers, and beer mugs.

A colorful, bird-shaped wooden sign painted with vibrant stripes and nature scenes, featuring the text "Lendep Huntsford" and "D & H Canal" along with illustrations of trees, mountains, a turtle, paw prints, and a canal boat.

A colorful, psychedelic-style wooden cutout shaped like a bird or leaf, featuring silhouettes of musicians, peace signs, flowers, and the words "PEACE LOVE MUSIC" in vibrant lettering, mounted on a post above a barrel planter filled with blooming flowers.

A vibrant, bird-shaped wooden sculpture painted with a colorful collage of wildlife—including a cougar, bear, fox, and various birds—stands mounted on a black pole atop a large rock, surrounded by mulch and small potted flowers in a grassy roadside setting.
A colorful, bird-shaped metal sign features musical instruments, flowers, and text reading "Reel Harmony Songwriter Festival" and "Peace Love and Music" against a bright yellow background.
A colorful, psychedelic wooden bird sculpture painted with peace signs, flowers, and the word "LIBERTY" in bold letters, set against a vibrant red background.
A smiling woman stands beside a large, colorful bird-shaped sign for the "Lenape Wurtsboro D & H Canal," which features vibrant rainbow stripes, painted landscapes, and wildlife symbols.
A colorful bird-shaped wooden sign features a vibrant forest scene with a blue wolf, deer, owl, raccoon, squirrel, and various birds nestled among trees and purple flowers.

A woman stands beside a large, colorful bird-shaped sign painted with a landscape scene featuring a black steam locomotive, mountains, trees, and buildings, with the text "O&W RAILROAD" prominently displayed in blue and red lettering.
A brightly colored, psychedelic bird-shaped sign features peace symbols, flowers, and beer mugs, with text reading "Hector's Inn Original Woodstock Watering Hole" and "Welcome to the Haight Ashbury."

A large, vibrantly painted bird sculpture stands in a wooden planter box, featuring colorful peace signs, handprints, and text reading "Walmart Mountain," "Soap Box Derby," and "Liberty Museum & Arts Center."

A woman in a black shirt and jeans stands smiling beside a large, colorful butterfly sculpture featuring a wolf, deer, and birds, mounted on a rock surrounded by flowers in a garden setting with other people in the background.
A vibrant, psychedelic mural shaped like a mustache depicts a 1960s hippie scene featuring a couple playing guitar by a campfire, a colorful VW bus, tents, peace signs, and flowers.
A painting of a twisted, leafless brown tree with intricate branches set against a vibrant, textured background of vertical rainbow-colored paint strokes.
A vibrant, multicolored owl with large yellow eyes perches on a dark branch against a textured yellow and orange background.
A painting of three pink coneflowers with yellow centers and green leaves set against a dark purple background.
